Record identity: `SCI-FLT-FIXED-PROPOSED-CONDITIONAL-FREEZE v0.1/freeze-candidate`

Status: proposed conditional scientific-owner freeze record; owner signature required; no freeze yet established

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Stage B date: `2026-08-31`

## Disposition

The SCI-FLT-FIXED v0.1 freeze candidate is eligible to be presented to the
scientific owner only if the durable verifier reproduces every authority-
manifest byte count and SHA-256, all 53 requirement and 30 prediction
identifiers and views remain exact, the PDFs rebuild byte-identically, and
every final page passes visual QA.

An unreproducible boundary, owner decision, profile, parity record, source, or
PDF makes only its dependent route typed unavailable and prevents this proposed
record from being presented as complete. The affected scientific claim or
route returns to typed unavailability.

## Conditional scope if signed

An explicit scientific-owner signature on this exact record may conditionally
freeze only:

- the fixed-convolution scientific method;
- exact product, response, covariance, support, lifecycle, identity-layer, and
  cross-package boundary meanings; and
- exact typed unavailable routes.

The condition is that `AUTHORITY_MANIFEST.json` and its external digest bind
the exact signed source packet and every verification result named above.

Even if signed, the freeze does not make an ordinary numerical MAP or JINC
parent available, register the FLT profiles, create a Registry evaluation or
numerical route, or authorize SCI-FLT-INF.

## Owner action still required

Only an explicit scientific-owner signature over the exact manifest-bound
record can establish the conditional freeze. This unsigned proposal is not
that action. Neither the proposal nor a later conditional scientific freeze
would establish implementation conformity, achieved response or covariance,
numerical adequacy, validation, calibration, observational performance,
readiness, production suitability, production authorization, or Unity
activity.
